items.title: string
items.desc: a string is a value wrapped in "" that can contain any character. Eg 1-9, a-z and some symbols

items.title: number
items.desc: a number is exactly what u think it is, its just a number. do not write any symbols or it will stop being a number

items.title: boolean
items.desc: a boolean or bool is used too tell if something is true or false

items.title: const
items.desc: const tells the Javascript this variable will never be changed

items.title: let
items.desc: let tells the Javascript this variable will change

items.title: var
items.desc: var tells the Javascript this is a variable without any spesific rules too it
